lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in a series of roughly vertical columns starting posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the posterior flank, forming a semi-regular 2D grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and a defined shadow area immediately ventral.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance circular spots bounded within the visible silhouette of the dorsal fin on the upper-left margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density clustering of significantly smaller, stochastic high-luminance spots compared to the larger, ordered blobs on the main flank.
